inference_wide.title: A100 · Transition (pair, n = 4) · inference · wide path, any D, any rows, bf16

kernels.name: LayerNorm
code: x_n = F.layer_norm(x, (D,), γ, β)   # bf16

kernels.name: expand + SwiGLU
kernels.impl: CUDA · dual_swiglu_kernel (mma.sync m16n8k16, pipelined cp.async ring)
code: a, b = x_n @ W_a.T, x_n @ W_b.T   # f32 accumulators
h = F.silu(a) * b                  # in the accumulators, rounded to bf16

kernels.name: squeeze + residual
kernels.impl: CUDA · gemm_res_kernel from 8192 rows, else cuBLAS + add_res_kernel
code: y = x + F.linear(h, W_s)   # rn(rn(h W_s.T) + x)

inference_fused.title: A100 · Transition (pair, n = 4 / 2) · inference · fused forward, D64 / D128

kernels.name: LN + expand + SwiGLU + squeeze + residual
kernels.impl: CUDA · tr_fwd_kernel<D, H> (a warp owns 32 rows for the whole hidden dimension)
code: x_n = F.layer_norm(x, (D,), γ, β)    # A fragments, in registers
for j in range(H // 16):             # 16 hidden units
a, b = x_n @ W_a[j].T, x_n @ W_b[j].T
h = F.silu(a) * b                  # C fragment = GEMM2's A fragment
acc += h @ W_s[:, j].T             # f16 accumulators, start at x
y = acc

training_wide.title: A100 · Transition (pair, n = 4) · training · wide path, any D, any rows, bf16

kernels.name: LayerNorm
code: x_n = F.layer_norm(x, (D,), γ, β)   # bf16; mean, rstd in fp32

kernels.name: expand + SwiGLU
code: a, b = x_n @ W_a.T, x_n @ W_b.T
h = F.silu(a) * b

kernels.name: squeeze + residual
kernels.impl: CUDA · gemm_res_kernel from 8192 rows, else cuBLAS + add_res_kernel
code: y = x + F.linear(h, W_s)

hbm.name: h
hbm.shape: [M,H] bf16 (not kept: recomputed in the backward)

kernels.name: dh GEMM
code: dh = dy @ W_s

kernels.name: gate (recomputes a, b)
kernels.impl: CUDA · gate_bwd_kernel (the dual GEMM of K2, dh tile prefetched into shared memory)
code: a, b = x_n @ W_a.T, x_n @ W_b.T
h, dA, dB = swiglu_bwd(dh, a, b)   # dB = dh silu(a); dA = dh b silu'(a)

kernels.name: dW GEMMs
code: dW_s = dy.T @ h
[dW_a; dW_b] = [dA | dB].T @ x_n

kernels.name: d_xn GEMM
code: d_xn = [dA | dB] @ [W_a; W_b]   # fp32

kernels.name: LayerNorm backward + residual
code: dx = dy + layer_norm_bwd(d_xn, x, mean, rstd, γ)
dγ, dβ = partials.sum(0)   # per-CTA partials, fixed order

training_fused.title: A100 · Transition (pair, n = 4 / 2) · training · fused forward and backward, D64 / D128

kernels.name: LN + expand + SwiGLU + squeeze + residual
code: x_n = F.layer_norm(x, (D,), γ, β)
for j in range(H // 16):
a, b = x_n @ W_a[j].T, x_n @ W_b[j].T
h = F.silu(a) * b
acc += h @ W_s[:, j].T
y = acc   # started at x

kernels.name: PW role: per hidden slice × row replica
code: dh, a, b = dy @ W_s[:, s], x_n @ W_a[s].T, x_n @ W_b[s].T
h, dA, dB = swiglu_bwd(dh, a, b)
dW_s[:, s] += dy.T @ h
dW_a[s] += dA.T @ x_n;  dW_b[s] += dB.T @ x_n   # f32 partials

kernels.name: X role: d_xn + LayerNorm backward
code: d_xn = Σ_j dA_j @ W_a[j] + dB_j @ W_b[j]
dx = dy + layer_norm_bwd(d_xn, x, mean, rstd, γ)

kernels.name: partial-sum reduction
code: dW_a, dW_b, dW_s = partials.sum(0)   # fixed order
dγ, dβ = partials_ln.sum(0)
